description.value: A functional MRI study examined emotion-regulation effects of reappraisal versus maintaining emotional responses on functional connectivity and neural activation in healthy individuals.

spans.text: In this fMRI study of 54 healthy individuals, we investigated alterations in connectivity within and between ICNs produced by the emotion regulation strategy of reappraisal.

instructions.value: During Maintain blocks, participants were instructed to attend to and experience their emotional state naturally without trying to change it. During Reappraise blocks, they were instructed to voluntarily decrease negative affect using cognitive reappraisal, either by transforming the scenario into less negative or positive terms or by rationalizing or objectifying the picture content. During Neutral Look blocks, they were instructed simply to look at neutral pictures.
